steps.description: A slide pack for the Capacity Committee on 19 November. One slide with the proposal at a glance and the margin a year. One slide on the six streams and what they are. One slide on where each stream goes and the capacity behind it. One slide on the price, full cost and margin against the floor. One slide comparing our price per ton with competitor pricing for each stream. One slide on the Caldwell Bend second line and what it adds from 2028. Close with the decision asked, then the sources.
